title: Approval.
officialText:
Lavatories shall conform to ANSI Z124.3, ASME A112.19.1M, ASME A112.19.2M, ASME A112.19.3M, ASME
A112.19.4M, ASME A112.19.9M, CSA B45.1, CSA B45.2, CSA B45.3 or CSA B45.4. Group wash-up equipment shall conform to
the requirements of Section PC 402. Every 20 inches (508 mm) of rim space shall be considered as one lavatory.
